cases.result: Exact dimension-six chromatic numbers: chi(Gamma_6) = 12 for lines and chi(O_6*) = 15 for all nonzero subspaces; a separation of three colors
cases.status: Joint manuscript and collaborator code in an open PR
cases.verification_scope: Independent finite certificates establish both exact chromatic numbers, with a weighted independent-set lower bound for the line graph. The full-subspace checker tests 2824 vertices and 3986076 pairs. Historical Lean build has native-evaluation axioms; do not describe as pure kernel validation. The all-dimensional clique formula has a separate existing Lean proof. Dimension seven and a structural full-subspace coloring rule remain open.

cases.result: Explicit Campbell recurrence formula with ratio liminf 2/5 and limsup 3/4; global golden structure and Fibonacci collars for Cloitre's recurrence
cases.status: Public PR #8 merged: exact cap-defect-two/three sublevels, five-row recursive closure and stronger local dispersion bounds
cases.verification_scope: Written proofs and exact finite checks. New interval and closure results hold on their stated Fibonacci-block domains with supplied context; global convergence and uniform dispersion remain open. No Lean formalization or agreed joint paper authorship.

cases.result: Analytic next-order constants for Catalan-square Hankel determinants, with exact c_(r+1) = 4 c_r for fixed integer shifts
cases.status: Substantive exchange and OEIS publication interest; joint note proposed
cases.verification_scope: Initial logarithmic-limit results have existing Lean formalization. Subsequent analytic constants and shift extensions are written proofs; quoted numerical quadrature is not interval-certified. No joint paper or new Lean formalization claimed.
